Rashi on Sotah 47b:12:1.english: Only for [a case of] uncertainty - And now they know who the killers are.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:13:1.hebrew: מנוקה מעון - ניאוף באשה האסורה לו, בין מזו שנסתרה בין מאחרת:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:13:1.english: Clear of transgression - [That is,] adultery with a woman forbidden to him, whether with this [wife] who secluded herself [with another man] or with another [woman].

Rashi on Sotah 47b:14:1.english: The transgression of his sons and his daughters - That they commit adultery.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:14:2.english: Not - [It] does not prevent his wife from being tested.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:14:3.hebrew: תא שמע לא אפקוד - לבדוק את הנשים, ומה טעם? על בנותיכם כי תזנינה:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:14:3.english: Come and hear: I will not punish - [Meaning,] to examine the women; and what is the reason? [Because of] "your daughters when they commit harlotry."

Rashi on Sotah 47b:17:1.hebrew: נתעוותו הדינין - דמתוך שהם בעלי הנאה, אין מטריחין עצמן לעיין בדין ובאיסור והיתר להורות לציבור, ומתוך כך נתקלקלו מעשיהם. וכיון שכן, אין להקב"ה נחת רוח בעולמו, ואין עולמו נוח לו:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:17:1.english: The laws became twisted - For because they are seekers of pleasure, they do not trouble themselves to delve into judgment or into [matters of] what is forbidden and what is permitted in order to instruct the community, and because of this their deeds became corrupted. And since this is so, the Holy One, blessed be He, has no satisfaction in His world, and His world is not pleasing to Him.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:1.hebrew: לוחשי לחישות - עורכי הדיינין, ומתלחשים עם הדיינין לפתוח להם פתח בזכותו של זה ובחובתו של זה:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:1.english: Those who whisper whisperings - [Those who] coach the judges, and whisper with the judges to open an opening for them in favor of this [one] and against that [one].

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:2.hebrew: רבה חרון אף - שעל הטיית המשפט חרון אף בא, שנאמר (שמות כ״ב:כ״ב) אם ענה תענה אותו וגו' וחרה אפי:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:2.english: Fierce anger proliferated - For through the perversion of justice, fierce anger comes, as it is stated (Exodus 22:22): "If you afflict him, etc., and My anger will burn."

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:3.english: [God] stands in the congregation of God - At the time when "in the midst of the judges He judges."

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:4.english: Those who go after their gain - for their own benefit.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:5.english: Those who say to evil good - [Meaning] that they praise the wicked.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:18:6.english: Woe, woe, proliferated - For "woe, woe" is written many times in that section.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:19:1.hebrew: מושכי הרוק - מאריכין הרוק, ומדת גאוה הוא:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:19:1.english: Those who draw out spittle - [They] lengthen [their] spittle, and it is a trait of arrogance.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:19:2.hebrew: ונתמעטו התלמידים - כדקי"ל (קידושין דף מט:), סימן לגסות הרוח עניות של תורה:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:19:2.english: And the students decreased - As it is established for us (Kiddushin 49b), a sign of haughtiness [is] poverty of Torah.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:19:3.english: Goes around to those who study it - [The Torah] goes around [to see if] perhaps it will find those who study it.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:1:1.hebrew: עד ימיו היה פטיש מכה בירושלים - בבית הנפחים בחולו של מועד, לעשות מלאכת דבר האבד שמותרת במועד. ועמד הוא וגזר על הנפחים אפילו בדבר האבד, מפני שקולן נשמע למרחוק, ואין הכל יודעין שהיא לדבר האבד. והכי אמרינן לה במועד קטן (יא.):
Rashi on Sotah 47b:1:1.english: Until his days the hammer would strike in Jerusalem - In the smithy, on the intermediate days of the festival, to perform work [involving] a matter of potential loss, which is permitted on the festival. And he arose and decreed against the smiths even for a matter of potential loss, because their noise is heard from afar and not everyone knows that it is for a matter of potential loss. And so we say it in Moed Katan (11a).

Rashi on Sotah 47b:1:2.hebrew: כל ימיו לא הוצרך אדם לשאל לחבירו על הדמאי - אם מעושר אם לאו, שהוא התקין שיהו כל הלוקחין מעם הארץ מעשרין:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:1:2.english: All his days no person needed to ask his fellow about demai - whether [it was] tithed or not, for he instituted that all who purchase from an am ha'aretz [unlearned person] should tithe [it].

Rashi on Sotah 47b:20:1.english: And in the end he is demeaned to them - [He becomes] despised in their eyes.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:1.hebrew: מטיל מלאי - הדיינים מטילין מלאי פרקמטיא שלהם על בעלי בתים היודעים בטיב סחורה, שישתכרו הדיינין על ידו:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:1.english: One who places merchandise - The judges place a stock of their merchandise upon householders who are knowledgeable about the quality of goods, so that the judges will profit through it.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:2.hebrew: רבו איש הישר בעיניו יעשה - שהרואה שהדיינין מסבירים לו פנים מפני טובה שעשה לו, ואינו מתיירא מהם:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:2.english: “[Every] man did that which was right in his eyes” proliferated - For one who sees that the judges show him favor because of a favor that he did for him [the judge], [acts as he pleases] and does not fear them.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:3.hebrew: שפלים הוגבהו - שאין אימת הגדולים על הקטנים, ואין ניכר בין גבוה לשפל:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:3.english: Lowly ones were raised - For there is no fear of the great upon the small, and there is no distinction between lofty and lowly.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:4.hebrew: ומלכותא - מלכותם של ישראל. אזלא ונולא — הולכת ומתנוולת:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:4.english: And the monarchy - the monarchy of Israel. Azla venavla — it goes and becomes degraded.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:5.english: Misers - [Those who refrain] from benefiting others with their money.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:21:6.english: Those who seize prey - Robbers, and those who harden [their] heart from having mercy on the poor.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:1.hebrew: רבו מים המרים - רבו המקנאים לנשותיהם, והיה למים המרים להרבות:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:1.english: The bitter waters proliferated - Those who were jealous of their wives proliferated, and the bitter waters were [bound] to proliferate.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:2.english: But they ceased giving them to drink - As we say that the waters do not test [her] once adulterers proliferated.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:3.hebrew: זחוחי הלב - שאין מטין את אזנם לשמוע יפה מפי רבם, וסומכים על בינתם לדקדק שמועתם:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:3.english: Those with haughty hearts - Who do not incline their ear to listen carefully from the mouth of their teacher, and [instead] rely on their [own] understanding to scrutinize their [received] teaching.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:22:4.english: Israel ahead - It is a euphemism.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:23:1.hebrew: שהכל בו - תורה באמתה, ואין דופי ושכחה ומחלוקת:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:23:1.english: That everything is in him - Torah in its truth, and there is no blemish, forgetfulness, or dispute.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:4:1.english: Even one [person] at the end of the world - [who] recognized him.

Rashi on Sotah 47b:5:1.hebrew: והא אמר עולא כו' - סוגיא זו כולה פירשתיה בפרק מי שקינא (לעיל סוטה לא:), ואינה חלוקה כאן כלום:
Rashi on Sotah 47b:5:1.english: And didn’t Ulla say, etc. - I have explained this entire sugya in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shekina (above, Sotah 31b), and it is not different here at all.
